info.title: Rally Event Operations API
info.description: Node.js API for HS-0130. Operational commands atomically commit state, immutable history and durable in-app notifications. Poll snapshots for live updates. Dates use ISO 8601 UTC.

post.description: Validates syntax and DNS mail delivery records. Creates an unverified account, session and durable verification email atomically. Verification is required for real events. Default local preview writes a private .eml; it does not send email. Native clients set X-Rally-Client: native and receive sessionToken. No automatic retry.

post.description: Stable key required per intent. Reuse it after a timeout, retry, crash or reconnect. Keys are unique per actor, retained indefinitely. Replay returns original entity with replayed=true. Same key with different payload: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH. Task updates require expectedVersion; stale writes: 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with details.current. Permissions, transaction, immutable history and notifications apply to every command. Only organisers assign and verify closure. See docs/API.md for transitions and payloads.
